description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter' responsible for converting units of length according to CSS standards, supporting various measurement systems and including methods for performing precise calculations with BCMath.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter
classes.description: A class for converting between different CSS length units, supporting systems like English and Metric, with methods for precise calculation and unit conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the converter with specified precision levels and optional BCMath usage enforcement.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an HTMLPurifier_Length object from its current unit to another specified unit, maintaining significant figures and handling unit systems.

methods.name: getSigFigs
methods.description: Returns the number of significant figures in a given string representing a decimal number.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two numeric strings with arbitrary precision if BCMath is available.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Multiplies two numeric strings with arbitrary precision if BCMath is available.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Divides two numeric strings with arbitrary precision if BCMath is available.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of significant figures, using BCMath if available.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Formats a floating point number to a specified number of decimal places, handling negative scales manually.
